name: Flamsteed
description: The Flamsteed was a large utilitarian freighter in operation around the time of the formation of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in 2 BBY. Manned by a small, peculiar crew, the starship flew the same uneventful route for several dozens of years, and on occasion, its crew accepted high-paying jobs to transport passengers to Yavin 4, an Outer Rim moon that served as an important base for anti-Imperial insurgents of the incipient rebellion. While the crew was comfortable with accepting these risky jobs, they needed to bribe key individuals along the way.
